changelog:
UPDATE EVERYTHONG DOWNLOADER TOOLS VERSION 1.2.0:
- Added native Windows Save File Dialog to choose destination folders directly without browser redirection.
- Added "Show in Folder" button to reveal completed downloads and conversions in Windows Explorer.
- Added Image Transcoding Studio supporting JPG, PNG, WebP, ICO, BMP, and TIFF with live image preview.
- Fixed infinite FFmpeg loop and 99% progress freeze when converting static images to video (MOV, MP4, MKV).
- Fixed FFmpeg crashes on silent videos with automatic stream detection and audio stripping (`-an`).
- Added Zero-Copy local file conversion to process large files instantly without HTTP upload overhead.
- Added 1-click Quick Conversion Presets and synchronized timeline Trimming controls.
- Replaced iframe with isolated Electron `<webview>` player for seamless embedded stream preview.
- Implemented 4-tier ad blocker eliminating pause popups, betting ads, and DevTools warnings.
- Fixed initial preview black screen and eliminated background audio leaking upon closing preview modal.
- Enforced 100% inline SVG vector icon standard, completely removing all legacy emojis and icon fonts.
- Styled native Windows scrollbars with custom theme and fixed horizontal preset button overflow.
- Upgraded `yt-dlp` with EJS challenge solver and improved TikTok cookie and captcha handling.
- Audited core dependencies in `requirements.txt` and resolved CLI builder static analysis warnings.
